mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish. Skies are clear at Verona Community Park with a current temperature of 61 degrees. A full moon is out tonight, and we have a great view of the space station at 8:34 PM as it rises over Cross Plains and heads toward Oregon, passing halfway up the sky. Tonight will cool down to a low of 48 degrees with no rain predicted.

In city news, the Planning Department is reminding everyone to be vigilant against scams involving fake planning or zoning application fees. Please remember that all official communication from the city will end in a veronawi.gov address. Also, please note that a segment of Highway M will be closed from October 5 to October 7 for final pavement work.

It is a busy weekend in the area. Today, you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market, or enjoy live music at Baileys Run, Paddy Macs, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, yoga is available at Insight Wellness on September 28, and you can test your knowledge with trivia at Hop Haus or the Wisconsin Brewing Company on September 29.
In our weekly police report, on September 10, officers responded to a burglary on Hunters Cove Way where an offender was apprehended after a shot was fired during the incident.
The Culver's flavor of the day is OREO REESE'S Cheesecake. The restaurant is open until 10:30 PM, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
